memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stable coronary artery disease with osteoporosis.
Patient reports occasional mild exertional chest discomfort relieved by rest, no dyspnea at rest. On exam: BP 138/84, pulse 78 regular, lungs clear, no peripheral edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.30 L (88%), FEV1/FVC 0.86; change since prior +0.02 L. Asthma Control Test score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct for salbutamol metered-dose inhaler (though not prescribed). Smoking status: former, quit 2005, pack-years 20.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Aspirin 75 mg OD
Atorvastatin 40 mg HS
Metoprolol succinate 25 mg OD
Isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD
Sublingual GTN SOS
Alendronate 70 mg once weekly
Calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3 400 IU
